text:
maria: Heads up — holding the v1.42.0 cut. integration-e2e keeps failing on the post-seed step and the image push also timed out. change window ends in ~45m, triage?
lee: saw the job stuck on upload to GCS. error snippet from the runner:```Uploading image to gcr.io/redwood-inference/releases/v1.42.0
ERROR: upload failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
Exit code: 1```
omar: that upload timeout correlates with a transient storage burst in eu-west-1 earlier — but tests also show a DB seed race. two independent failures, could be unrelated.
jen: release notes are ready, but we can't ship until CI is green. we need a clear action: pin artifact and re-run, or rollback to last stable tag?
ci-runner: retried integration-e2e (attempt 2) — currently in queue. previous attempt failed during seed with: `psql: error: could not serialize access due to concurrent update`.
maria: ok options: (1) pin the image to last-good digest and re-run promotion path, (2) rerun the flaky job a few times and hope for green, or (3) rollback the release and cut a hotfix later. I prefer pin+rerun given change window.
lee: I can trigger a manual promote to a pinned sha if we decide. which sha? last-green is `sha256:3bd7f9a2`.
omar: small footnote — the integration job started failing after the baseimage bump in the buildkite step. PR #4123 bumped baseimage from debian -> ubuntu:22.04. Could be related.
jen: if we pin the image but the underlying test flake is unrelated to upload, we'll still see failures. so we should pin artifact AND skip the baseimage bump on this cut. fast rollback of that PR is possible.
maria: decision: pin to sha256:3bd7f9a2 + revert PR #4123 in the release branch, then retrigger integration-e2e. if upload fails again, we abort the cut and roll back to v1.41.8.
lee: doing the pin now — updating the release manifest and kicking off a manual promote. @deploy-bot please hold auto-promo.
deploy-bot: auto-promotion paused for thread 1733333334 by lee. manual promote requested.
ci-runner: manual promote started at 1733333520. build step succeeded, pushing image to registry...
ci-runner: push failed on attempt 1 with DeadlineExceeded, retrying (attempt 2).
lee: if GCS keep timing out we should consider routing image pushes to an alternate region (temp). not ideal but unblockable.
omar: I've opened a telemetry ticket for storage spikes and added a note linking to infra incident #INC-2026.
jen: pushing change-note to release-notes.md: add "release delayed due to infra flakiness; pinned to last-good image".
maria: timeline: if we don't have a successful promote by 1733333934 (20m), we abort and roll back. everyone ok?
lee: agreed. monitoring the promote and e2e. :eyes:
omar: on standby to revert PR and prepare rollback branch if needed.
maria: thanks all — keep updates short.
ci-runner: manual promote succeeded at 1733333605. integration-e2e now running.
ci-runner: integration-e2e passed after retry. all checks green.
jen: yay — updating the changelog and unlocking release notes for publishing.
lee: will kick off final promote to production now. @deploy-bot you may resume auto-promote for future cuts.
deploy-bot: auto-promotion resumed by lee. release cut v1.42.0 promoted at 1733333720.
